set.rappel_count_note: About seven rappels on a single 60 m rope down the East Ridge to the Cascade-Johannesburg col: one rope-stretcher (or two shorter) to a big block, two or three more to the heather, then a downclimb to a slightly hidden station and two more to the col. Six to eight are all reported and the spread is a choice, not a conflict - the first rappel can be split, the gully to climber's right can be downclimbed instead, and how much heather you rappel versus scramble varies. Bring cord: many stations are slings around blocks and are routinely rebuilt.
set.descent: Doug's Direct: from the summit, descend the East Ridge to the Cascade-Johannesburg col (~6,760 ft), about seven rappels on a single 60 m rope mixed with downclimbing, then traverse beneath the south faces of Cascade Peak and the Triplets, sideslope steep meadows, and climb to the crest of Mixup Peak's north ridge — the crossover point is not obvious and is a common source of route-finding trouble. From there descend 3rd/4th-class rock and steep heather on the north side of Mixup, cross the Cache Glacier, and follow climbers' trails back down to Cascade Pass and the trailhead. Expect 4-6 hours from the col to the parking lot; this is not simply reversing the East Ridge/CJ Couloir.
set.rappels: About 7 rappels on a single 60 m rope down the East Ridge to the Cascade-Johannesburg col (6 to 8 depending on how much you downclimb), then descend via Doug's Direct or Cache Col
